`class ModelNode`<br/>
**Extends:** [`BaseModelNode`](/reference/nodes/basemodelnode/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.model` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ModelNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/model/ModelNode.java)

Draws a 3D model at a zoom and a rotation that your code sets.

![A textured cube turned to show its front, side and top faces](/captures/catalog-nodes-modelnode.webp)
